name: StarChat Alpha
description:
Here is how to read the StarChat Alpha config.json. The architecture class is GPTBigCodeForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 6,144: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 49,156 × 6,144: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 48, so each head sees 128 dimensions (6,144 / 48). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 6144 / 48 = 128. 128 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_hidden_layers is 40: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 24,576. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 6,144-wide stream is projected up, activated, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

vocab_size is 49,156. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

torch_dtype is float16.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceH4/starchat-alpha/blob/main/config.json.
